summary: Inventory plugins point Ansible at data sources to build its host inventory, through -i with a path or a comma-separated host list, or other configuration sources. Custom ones can be written.
questions: Can I pass a list of hosts directly on the command line?
Can I build inventory from my own data source?

answer_card.title: What inventory plugins are
answer_card.answer_md: Inventory plugins compile the host list from data sources, using `-i /path/to/file`, `-i 'host1, host2'`, or other configuration sources. You can write custom ones.
